scope: Metadata-only resolution of the user-provided v1 magnet; no payload downloads.
method: Ten separate engine processes with fresh temporary state, DHT enabled and peer_encryption=prefer. OS DNS caches and the public swarm are uncontrolled.
controlled_regressions: A healthy provider behind 64 silent peers resolves before the 14-second test deadline.
Transient failure of the only provider remains retryable.
Four shared dictionary allocations remain the limit across simultaneous lookups; keepalives cannot retain a buffer indefinitely.
Silent TCP handshakes preserve encrypted uTP fallback; focused test passed in 6.28 seconds.
limits_of_evidence: This is a measured performance target, not a universal deadline guarantee. Unreachable trackers, absent peers, network outages, or exceptionally large/slow metadata can prevent resolution within 15 seconds.

validation.parallel_run_note: The final parallel v2 run passed 73 tests; the file-move cancellation test hit its existing initial-verification timeout while compilation and live lookups were running. The unchanged test passed alone in 21.98 seconds. No file-management code or timeout was changed.
